title: Software Watchdog Timer
text: Output true until counter reaches maximum count limit, 1 input, 1 output, {Counter data type} sets Data type of Status output; {Maximum count} sets the maximum limit of watchdog timer value. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Restart
ports.summary: Pulse to restart watchdog timer counter scalar

params.name: Maximum count
params.values: Maximum limit of watchdog timer value 10 (default) | scalar

params.name: Counter data type
params.values: Data type of Status output uint8 (default) | uint16 | uint32
